summary: The United States conducted secret strikes on Iranian missile launchers and military equipment, concealed ahead of midterm elections, while Israel killed six Palestinian operatives in Gaza and conducted strikes in southern Lebanon. Iran tested a ballistic missile from Yazd, launched UAVs from Omidiyeh and Marivan, and an IRGC advisor claimed missile bases are immune to conventional weapons. A foiled combined attack in Jerusalem involved a 19-year-old from Beit Hanina who planned to detonate an explosive at Lions Gate and shoot at police and worshippers at the Temple Mount.
key_points: The U.S. carried out covert strikes in Iran targeting missile launchers and military equipment, withheld from public view before midterm elections. (Source: @yediotnews25/137326)
Israeli strikes in Gaza killed six Palestinian operatives, including Hamas and Islamic Jihad commanders, accused of violating the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59473)
Iran test-launched a ballistic missile from Yazd Province and conducted UAV activity in Marivan and Omidiyeh. (Source: @shin_persian/12025, @shin_persian/12016, @shin_persian/12023)
An IRGC Aerospace Force advisor stated Iranian missile bases are deep underground and impervious to conventional weapons, ready to strike Israel and U.S. bases. (Source: @yediotnews25/137319)
Lebanese health ministry confirmed one killed and one wounded in an Israeli drone strike on a motorcycle in Qabrikha. (Source: @manniefabian/59480)
Daily Lebanese alert data shows 124 alerts, 80 drone sightings, five air strikes, and ten artillery shelling incidents across southern districts. (Source: @redlinkleb/51813)
A U.S. C-17 Globemaster III strategic transport flight was tracked over Palestine. (Source: @redlinkleb/51831)
Israeli security forces foiled a two-year plot by a 19-year-old from Beit Hanina to attack Lions Gate and the Temple Mount. (Source: @yediotnews25/137322)

Iran tested a ballistic missile from Yazd, launched UAVs from Omidiyeh and Marivan, and an IRGC advisor claimed missile bases are immune to conventional weapons. points: A ballistic missile test launch occurred early morning from Yazd, Yazd Province, Iran, as reported by monitoring channels. (Source: @shin_persian/12025)

UAV activity was observed in Marivan, Kurdistan Province, and a UAV was launched from Omidiyeh, Khuzestan Province, indicating ongoing drone operations. (Source: @shin_persian/12016, @shin_persian/12023)
Jet activity was heard in Dezful, Khuzestan Province, suggesting possible Iranian Air Force movements. (Source: @shin_persian/12009)

IRGC Aerospace Force advisor Ali Balali claimed missile bases across Iran are deep underground, immune to conventional weapons, capable of striking Israel and U.S. bases, and ready for immediate launch. (Source: @yediotnews25/137319)

The Wall Street Journal reported U.S. forces conducted covert strikes in Iran targeting missile launchers and military equipment weeks ago, hidden before midterm elections, with VP Vance and Secretary Rubio informed. (Source: @yediotnews25/137326)
A state-run show in Tehran featured an actor dressed as Trump in a cage on a billboard in Tajrish Square, culminating in a symbolic execution. (Source: @shin_persian/12024)
A USAF OSA flight from Munich en route to CENTCOM AOR with a possible DV VIP on board was tracked, indicating high-level U.S. military movement in the region. (Source: @shin_persian/12010)

Israeli strikes in Gaza killed six Palestinian operatives: Mahmoud Jihad Mohammad Qafa (Hamas sniper cell commander) and Asaad Suleiman Salman Qashta (Army of Islam smuggling facilitator) in Khan Younis on Monday; Mohammad Zakaria Al-Jamal (Hamas cell commander), Mohammad Amin Al-Namas (Hamas operative), Shaher Mohammad Zaarab (Nukhba Force company commander), and Mohammad Ali Abu Shaar (Islamic Jihad sniper) in Khan Younis on Sunday. (Source: @manniefabian/59473)

Israeli drone strike on a motorcycle in Qabrikha, southern Lebanon, killed one person (identified as Muhammad Nasser Yousef) and wounded another, per Lebanese health ministry. (Source: @manniefabian/59480)

Israeli artillery shelling hit multiple locations in southern Lebanon: Barashit (3), Zoutar al-Sharqiya (2), Wadi al-Hujeir (1), Beit Yahoun (1), Wadi Zibqin (1), Al-Mansouri (1), Haris (1), Mayfadoun (1). (Source: @redlinkleb/51813, @redlinkleb/51771, @redlinkleb/51815)
Israeli air strikes struck Taloussa (2), Aita al-Jabal al-Zat (1), Wadi al-Hujeir (1), Kfar Tibnit (1) in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/51813, @redlinkleb/51795)
Israeli warplanes were observed over southern Lebanon and heading south, per real-time alerts. (Source: @redlinkleb/51786, @redlinkleb/51788)
A U.S. C-17 Globemaster III strategic transport aircraft (tail 96-0002) flew over Palestine at 33,200 ft on a strategic airlift mission. (Source: @redlinkleb/51831)

Israel has approximately $10 billion in outstanding orders for U.S. military equipment not covered by existing aid commitments through 2028, complicating aid phase-out plans. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9613)

Six Palestinian terror operatives were killed in Israeli strikes in the Gaza Strip earlier this week, including Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad commanders, all accused of advancing attacks on troops and civilians in violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59473)

In Khan Younis, southern Gaza, two operatives were killed Monday: Mahmoud Jihad Mohammad Qafa, commander of a Hamas sniper cell, and Asaad Suleiman Salman Qashta, member of Army of Islam facilitating smuggling. (Source: @manniefabian/59473)

Four operatives were killed Sunday in Khan Younis: Mohammad Zakaria Al-Jamal (Hamas cell commander), Mohammad Amin Al-Namas (Hamas operative), Shaher Mohammad Zaarab (commander of a company in Hamas elite Nukhba Force), and Mohammad Ali Abu Shaar (Islamic Jihad sniper operative). (Source: @manniefabian/59473)

The IDF and Shin Bet stated all operatives had recently been advancing attacks on troops and Israeli civilians and acted to restore terror capabilities in systematic violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59473)

Israeli security forces foiled a combined attack in Jerusalem: a 19-year-old from Beit Hanina planned for two years to detonate an explosive at Lions Gate, enter the Temple Mount, and shoot at Jews and police. (Source: @yediotnews25/137322)
Lebanese health ministry confirmed one killed and one wounded in an Israeli drone strike on a motorcycle in Qabrikha, southern Lebanon, this afternoon. (Source: @manniefabian/59480)

sections.threat_assessment: The covert U.S. strikes on Iranian missile infrastructure signal a significant escalation in kinetic pressure on Iran, while Iran's ballistic missile test and UAV deployments demonstrate continued readiness for retaliation. Israel's simultaneous operations in Gaza and Lebanon, killing senior Hamas and Islamic Jihad commanders, indicate a sustained campaign to degrade terrorist capabilities despite ceasefire frameworks. The foiled Jerusalem attack reveals persistent internal threats. Iran's claim of hardened missile bases suggests a high threshold for conventional deterrence, raising the risk of miscalculation if either side tests red lines.
sections.regional_response: Lebanese health ministry and local alert networks document ongoing Israeli strikes, with daily drone sightings and artillery shelling across southern districts, but no reported Lebanese state military response. The U.S. C-17 flight over Palestine and OSA flight to CENTCOM AOR reflect heightened American logistical and command presence. Gulf states are not directly mentioned, but the reported tripling of logistics costs and doubling of fuel costs due to the Iran war implies economic strain across the region. Political developments in Israel, including coalition negotiations, may influence future military decision-making.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Wall Street Journal's revelation of secret U.S. strikes in Iran, withheld for electoral reasons, indicates a deliberate information operation to manage domestic perceptions while conducting kinetic actions. Iran's symbolic execution of a Trump effigy in Tehran signals propaganda escalation. The $10 billion in outstanding Israeli military orders not covered by aid commitments through 2028 suggests long-term procurement planning amid uncertainty over U.S. support. The 101st Airborne's development of new doctrine around the MV-75 Cheyenne II tilt-rotor indicates U.S. preparation for rapid air assault capabilities in the theater.
